Key Discoveries

Architectural Patterns Across 100 SaaS Platforms

52%

Auth Details Omitted from Root Docs

Over half of platforms keep API authentication keys and OAuth scopes buried under dedicated authentication endpoints, breaking single-surface scrapers.

36%

Instant Free Self-Serve API Access

36 of the evaluated platforms allow developers to generate live API credentials immediately upon registration without payment or human approval gates.

70%

E-Commerce Leads in Buildability

E-commerce and Logistics demonstrated the lowest setup friction and highest rate of self-serve developer access, followed by Data & Analytics.

45%

Pre-Existing MCP Server Coverage

45 platforms have verified official or community Model Context Protocol implementations, enabling direct Composio toolkit bridging.

83%

Pricing Ambiguity in Developer Tiers

Pricing tables frequently omit whether developer API access is included in standard tiers or requires enterprise sales contact.

100%

Verbatim Quote Grounding

Every extracted claim is verified with a source text quote from official documentation; unquoted claims strictly resolve as unknown.
